title: The Name of Every Herb
youtube_title: The Name of Every Herb | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting your turn to talk lets someone feel heard.
summary: At a cottage hearth with the clock unhurried, Auntie June begins to tell Bodhi about a names of herbs, which sound alike until the last one. Bodhi wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
